actions.reason: Strong biological support: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon/inflammatory pathways with large effect sizes, and WXS shows significant BAP1 enrichment (q=0.0044). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with median support count 3 and positive RNA/WSI silhouettes. Confounder exclusion shows a significant site enrichment (CJ) but this is a single technical factor and does not override the coherent biological signal. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

No significant biological enrichment across RNA, WXS, or CNV (all q near 1.0). Strong technical confounding: significant associations with CT manufacturer, scanner model, and kernel (q<0.05), and CT is the only modality with positive silhouette (0.276), indicating the set is primarily defined by technical imaging factors rather than biology. Cross-modal consistency is weak outside CT. The set lacks a defensible biological identity and is better explained by technical variation.

No significant biological enrichment across any modality (all q high). Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes in most modalities and low patient support (median 2). No significant technical confounders, but the absence of any biological signal and lack of structural cohesion indicate the set is not a distinct biological entity. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

Biological support is primarily transcriptional with no significant mutation or CNV enrichment. Cross-modal consistency is weak (median silhouettes near zero, low patient support). No significant technical confounders, but the lack of corroborating genomic evidence and weak structural cohesion indicate the set is not a robust biological entity. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

Biological support is coherent across RNA and CNV: RNA shows extensive FDR-significant pathway enrichment (immune downregulation, heme metabolism upregulation) and CNV shows significant lower copy-number on multiple arms. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and high resampling ARI (0.561). Confounder exclusion shows no significant per-set technical associations. The set has a defensible identity with corroborating evidence across modalities.
